title: Fit the mixer bowl on its side pins and latch the back
instruction: Fit the empty bowl onto the lowered mixer arms. Seat both side tabs over their pins, press the back of the bowl into the spring latch, and let go.
context: A cook installing a mixer bowl needs to secure its back as well as its sides. A bowl can look level on the pins and still wobble if its rear stud rests on top of the latch.
setup: Use the unpowered mixer replica and matched bowl from fabrication/BUILD.md. Bolt the lowered cradle to the bench. Leave the red fixed head and tool shaft fitted with the beater removed. The steel 6.4 mm pins are 246.4 mm apart and their shoulders are 128 mm above the bench. Set the 0.60 kg weighted empty bowl on its foot 176 mm ahead of the pin line, handle toward the operator. The orange catch rests at its forward stop.
scoring: Score the final uninterrupted second, or finish early when the 1.0 state lasts a second. Use synchronized views of both yellow pin tops, the left and right rear pocket windows, and both hands. Score 0.5 if each yellow pin passes through its own closed tab and projects 5–9 mm above the top face of the tab (7.6 mm with the tab resting on the shoulder). The tab top lies between the two black height rings on the pin. Use the 6.4 mm steel shank for scale. Both hands must be visibly clear of the bowl and spring catch throughout that second. Hands can finish above, in front of, beside, or between the tabs wherever they have let go. Judge actual contact with the bowl or catch. Score 1 if during the same second both blue stud ends sit entirely below and behind the orange lip in the respective pocket windows, and the collar stays within the 3 mm mark at its forward stop. The stud centre must be 5–15 mm above the pocket floor and 5–15 mm behind its front face at each window. A stud on the ramp or a retracted catch caps the score at 0.5. One missed tab or continued hand support earns zero. A pin touching the inside wall of a closed ear and a blue stud touching the underside of the lip both count when their visible positions meet these marks. A failed attempt may be retried.
reset_notes: Support the bowl by its handle or rim, retract the guided spring catch, lift the rear stud clear and lift both ears off their pins. Release the catch and return the bowl to its foot mark.
fidelity: Original full-size unpowered bowl-lift mixer reconstruction. The matched bench replica uses a rigid polymer housing and permanently metal-weighted bowl. It reproduces the 226 mm rim, 6.4 mm steel locating shanks, closed ear openings and external rear stud. The guided spring and open windows expose the capture. The fixed head remains over the bowl. The motor and dough mixing are omitted.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (830 recorded steps). Scripted demo: 1.0 (805 recorded steps, first full score at step 761 under the revised rule).
